extracted.name: Sparkling Holiday Jam
extracted.description: This strawberry-cranberry jam is delightful. It tastes great and looks beautiful in a jar with a ribbon in a Christmas or holiday basket to share.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) package fresh or frozen cranberries, coarsely chopped
instruction_lines: Sterilize jars and lids in boiling water for at least 10 minutes. Let simmer while making jam.
Combine strawberries, cranberries, pectin, and margarine in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Stir in sugar and return to a boil. Cook for 1 minute; remove from heat.
Quickly fill jars to within 1/2 inch from the top. Wipe rims clean and put on lids. Process in a boiling water bath for 5 minutes.
